critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MongoDB _id serialization issue in /app/backend/routes/contacts.py - was returning ObjectId after insert_one() causing 500 errors on contact and group creation

bug_fixes_applied.issue: POST /api/contacts and POST /api/contacts/groups returning 500 Internal Server Error
bug_fixes_applied.root_cause: MongoDB insert_one() adds _id field to the document dict. When returning the dict directly, the ObjectId cannot be JSON serialized.
bug_fixes_applied.fix: Added contact_dict.pop('_id', None) and group_dict.pop('_id', None) after insert_one() to remove the _id before returning response
